Here are 3 key technical facts/actionable insights:

1. The webpage is using a technique called "Skip navigation" to allow users to skip unnecessary navigation links and focus on the main content.
2. The webpage is utilizing a search bar to enable users to search for content and get started with the platform.
3. The YouTube platform is using a "feed" system to personalize video recommendations based on the user's viewing history and engagement.

• YouTube is a video-sharing platform.
• The platform has a "Skip navigation" feature.
• Users can create subscriptions and start watching videos to build a personalized feed.

• Gmail has over 1.5 billion active users worldwide.
• Gmail's search function can find emails based on keywords, sender, recipient, and subject.
• Gmail offers two-factor authentication to add an extra layer of security to user accounts.

• "Laila Main Laila" is SRK's highest viewed song on YouTube.
• The song features Sunny Leone and was part of the 2012 film Raees.
• The song has over 1 billion views on YouTube.

* Yahoo is owned by Apollo Global Management and Verizon Media.
* Yahoo's primary revenue streams come from advertising and search services.
* Yahoo's stock was listed on the NASDAQ under the ticker symbol YHOO from 1996 to 2017.

• YouTube was founded in 2005 by three former PayPal employees.
• YouTube has over 2 billion monthly active users.
• YouTube's content is available in over 80 languages.
